audit_result.proof_trace: The canonical list endpoint (getAllMembers) correctly applies .is('deleted_at', null) at L18, but syncRoles queries the members table by discord_uid only with no deleted_at filter (L25-29), allowing soft-deleted members to be fetched and operated on. The same codebase applies the filter consistently in getAllMembers and syncAllRoles, confirming the omission in syncRoles is unintentional. updateNickname (nickname.ts L63-67) has the identical missing filter.
audit_result.attack_scenario: An authenticated API caller posts to POST /api/roles/sync with a soft-deleted member's discord_uid; syncRoles retrieves the deleted member record (no deleted_at guard), and if they remain in the Discord server, re-grants all their original club roles (generation, team, leader, member, verified) — reversing the intended effect of soft-deletion.

PROP-api-request-inv-015.text: Soft-deleted members (deleted_at != null) must not be accessible via active member queries.
